defaults.prerequisites: Create hostile fixtures on a real temporary supported local filesystem.
defaults.action: Exercise all six operations through the core dispatcher with one explicit project root.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: require and canonicalize one explicit selected project root before processing every operation
rows.oracle: Missing roots fail project_root_required; missing or unsupported selected roots fail before operation payloads are interpreted; a link used only in the supplied root route is accepted.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: reject every linked, mounted, redirected, case-aliased, or Unicode-aliased descendant contract path
rows.oracle: Secure descendant walks reject links and ambiguous aliases for definitions, Inputs, Runs, Results, locks, and temporary or final publication directories.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: reject known remote filesystems and detectable synchronized or redirected storage
rows.oracle: Controlled NFS, SMB/CIFS, remote mount, FUSE-remote, UNC, reparse, and visible synchronization indirection fixtures fail unsupported_filesystem or fail closed before access.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: confine Breakdown-owned state and make it current-user-only by default
rows.oracle: Only the Run directory and Breakdown-owned .breakdown transient locations change; new POSIX directories and files are 0700 and 0600, and existing Workflow Input permissions remain unchanged.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: fail closed on validation-to-open and staging-to-publication replacement races
rows.oracle: Input identity changes and replacement of Run or StepArtifact temporary and destination directories produce no redirected authoritative commit.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: keep project content structurally separated from Run Authority
rows.oracle: Hostile prompts, Inputs, Results, extensions, and filenames remain data; Work Packet policy, task, Input descriptors, Result requirements, and submission identity remain distinct.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: perform no project-directed execution, import, hook, Git, network, environment, credential-discovery, or undeclared-context side effect
rows.oracle: Hostile adjacent instructions, package hooks, repositories, environment files, URLs, templates, and command strings are neither loaded nor acted upon.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: keep ambient credentials and privileged host configuration out of durable and transient operation values
rows.oracle: Sentinel ambient secrets do not appear in Runs, StepArtifacts, Work Packets, diagnostics, logs, extensions added by the core, or child environments; the core creates no child process.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: reject special files and preserve exact Input identity and permissions
rows.oracle: Directories, devices, FIFOs, sockets, links, hard links, replacements, and mutations fail before disclosure or commit while ordinary Input mode bits remain unchanged.

rows.requirement: Issue #157: enforce the complete fixed limit profile without truncation or partial durable commits
rows.oracle: Every applicable limit-minus-one and limit value succeeds exactly; limit-plus-one fails resource_limit/limit_exceeded with no partial Run or StepArtifact.
